subject: Re: MAP & Commit Structure — Skylark media onboarding
messages:
From: Jessica Luo <jessica@skylarkmedia.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ramesh@skylarkmedia.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Skylark MAP — proposed commits & timeline

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency profile and the clear cost breakdown. Leadership asked me to share a draft of the mutual action plan so we can align on commitments and dates. High-level asks from our side:

- A 3-month eval with a staged commit if performance meets the thresholds (we expect to ramp volume from ~200M TPM to 750M TPM by month 6).
- Pricing that includes a ramp discount: 5% at 250M TPM, 10% at 500M TPM, 15% at 750M TPM.
- A firm SLA window for token latency at 95th percentile.

I attached a one-pager (Skylark-MAP-v2.pdf) with our proposed milestones and acceptance criteria. Can Redwood confirm whether these TPM breakpoints and discount triggers are acceptable and what the billing cadence would look like if we move to a commit?

Also looping in Ramesh (product) for acceptance criteria — he’ll follow up with technical questions.

Best,
Jessica
Head of Product, Skylark Media
[Attachment: Skylark-MAP-v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Luo <jessica@skylarkmedia.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skylark MAP — proposed commits & timeline

Jessica — thanks for the MAP and clear targets. Quick read-through: the staged ramp and discount ladder are workable, but we have a few standard guardrails and options we want to offer to keep economics predictable for both sides. Key points: 

1) Commit tiers: we can structure monthly TPM commitments in a 3-tier ladder (250M / 500M / 750M). Each tier has an associated unit price; discounts you listed can be applied as post-commit rebates or built into the committed rate.

2) Ramp protection: for the first 90 days we'll include a 20% flexible buffer — meaning you can underutilize up to 20% of the committed TPM without penalty while you finish integration. After day 91, true-ups apply monthly.

3) Milestone credits: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to 1 month at 250M TPM) if you complete the acceptance checklist by the end of month 1.

4) SLA / rollback: if 95th pct latency exceeds the agreed SLO for two consecutive weeks during the eval, we will provide a temporary rollback to the previous model variant and cover the delta in token charges for that period.

Ben and Priyom are cc’d for pricing and acceptance criteria verification. I’m attaching our suggested pricing workbook (redwood-pricing-v3.xlsx).

Next step: if these guardrails look acceptable, propose we lock a MAP and run a pilot starting Sept 1.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, jessica@skylarkmedia.com
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skylark MAP — proposed commits & timeline

Quick pricing note for the record. We ran the expected token mix Jessica shared and have two viable pricing structures:

A) Commit-first: Lower committed unit price, monthly true-ups, discounts applied once you hit the TPM thresholds in a calendar month.

B) Credit-first: Slightly higher committed unit price but with measurable onboarding credits and a guaranteed 30-day trial credit bucket that offsets early spikes while you tune prompts.

If Skylark expects bursty traffic in month 1, B removes short-term cost risk. Structuring discounts as monthly rebate (retroactive) is simpler for billing. We should confirm whether Skylark prefers rebates vs. upfront discounted committed rate — both are fine.

Also: our legal team prefers tying the 15% discount to a minimum 9-month commitment at the 750M tier (protects capacity planning). We can make a one-time exception for a 6-month term with an escrowed usage guarantee — but that would reduce the discount to 12%.

Ben
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Luo <jessica@skylarkmedia.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skylark MAP — acceptance checklist and thresholds

Hi Jessica — a couple of technical clarifications from our side to make acceptance deterministic: 

- Acceptance check: 95th pct latency <= 240ms for 75 token outputs on the internal staging model, measured over 72-hour rolling window.
- Stability gate: no more than 1% error rate (5xx / total requests) across the staged pool during the 7-day pre-production window.
- TPM measurement: we will report committed TPM based on billed tokens (sum of input + output tokens) using Redwood’s accounting window (UTC, monthly).

If you can confirm these thresholds, we’ll add them to the MAP doc and generate the MAP acceptance checklist. Once accepted, the onboarding credit will be triggered automatically. Attaching a draft checklist for review.

Cheers,
Priyom
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-acceptance-checklist.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Jessica Luo <jessica@skylarkmedia.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skylark MAP — acceptance checklist and thresholds

Thanks — that all looks reasonable. Two quick asks from our side: 

1) Can Redwood include a clause that caps Skylark’s exposure for month 1 to 120% of the projected TPM in the event of an integration spike? We want to avoid surprise bills during initial tuning.
2) Can the 750M/15% discount be split so the 15% only applies to incremental usage above 500M? That helps us test the top-end traffic before committing to full discount exposure.

If you can accept those two edits, I can route a revised MAP to our CFO for signature and we’ll target a Sept 1 pilot.

Best,
Jessica

Subject: Re: Skylark MAP — finalization and next steps

Jessica — great, we can accept both asks with small edits:

- Month 1 cap: we’ll cap your exposure at 120% of projected TPM for the first billing cycle OR apply the 30-day credit bucket (whichever is more favorable to Skylark).
- Discount application: 15% will be applied to incremental usage above 500M TPM. The committed rate for the first 500M remains at the agreed tiered pricing.

I’ve looped in Marissa from our deals team to shepherd legal and DocuSign. Marissa — can you prepare the MAP with the edits above and a draft term (6-month vs 9-month options) and circulate a track-changed version to Skylark? If Skylark signs before Aug 26, we’ll guarantee a Sept 1 pilot start and honor the onboarding credit.

Thanks — pleased to get this across the line.

Lauren
